svg.aria-label: Request path: clients call one Ambit gateway, built on agentgateway, which checks the caller and their access, asks the budget service, guard, token broker and router as needed, then forwards to AI models or MCP servers and sends audit records through the OpenTelemetry Collector to ClickHouse. Setup: your identity provider signs people in through Dex and reports leavers to the console by SCIM; admins use the console, which stores Ambit objects; ambit-controller turns them into gateway configuration.
svg.title: Ambit architecture: requests pass one gateway to AI models and MCP servers; admins and your identity provider set it up through the console.
